title: Needs more symptoms
body: Good but could be much better. Incredibly enough, there is no option for women to enter or hint at things that can affect, not only period (such as menopause or at least check age when it may be possible to start getting those different symptoms) and even simple things like a tooth extraction that affects diet and amount of exercise we can get during several days while in recovery. Adding that to symptoms would help understand why an improvement trend suddenly stops for a few days. This could even be adding a “why are you pausing your rings?” on the watch so the reason is recorded when it happens.
